text:
mike: Deploybot just flagged a surge in OOMs for quant model 'redwood-quant-v2' in eu-west1 canary. Error rate and tail latency spiking. Want to push a fastpatch pin to v2.1.3-quant-fix + KV-cache bounds guard. Need expedited approvals from releases, ml-infra, and oncall.
priya: saw the same on dashboards. Canary replicas 3/5 hit OOM within 30m after increased long-request traffic.
jordan: is the kv bounds change small and safe? any perf downside risk?
kevin (ml-infra): it's a small guard: cap per-request KV keys to 8 and early-evict large prefixes. I ran staging perf with long sequences (6k tokens) and 95th pct unchanged. Should prevent OOMs.
tess (oncall): what's the rollback criteria? need clear SLOs before I ack watching.
mike: rollback if 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > +200ms vs baseline for 10m. Auto-fallback to 'redwood-quant-v2-legacy' if deploybot flags degraded.
priya: +1 from releases, this is affecting EU dedicated customers.
jordan: +1 but keep canary at 5% for 10m before ramping.
kevin (ml-infra): pushing image and pin now. Deploy command: ```bash
deploybot release start --service=ml-serving --model=redwood-quant-v2 --image=redwood-quant:v2.1.3-quant-fix --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --auto-rollback=false --meta=\"expedite:oom-kv-guard\"
```
releasebot: @mike created release 2026.03.17-quant-fix (id r-20260317-07). Draft release notes: "KV-cache bounds guard to prevent OOMs on redwood-quant-v2; pins image to v2.1.3-quant-fix."
priya: add ops contact and the rollback criteria into the notes.
mike: done. Anyone object to skipping the standard 30m full canary because of severity?
jordan: prefer staged ramp: 5% -> 30% -> full, but stop early if oncall sees issues.
tess (oncall): I'll monitor gpu_memory_free, 5xx_rate, p95_latency in real-time and call rollback if thresholds hit.
kevin (ml-infra): image pushed, PR merged `fix/kv-cache-guard` -> main, release tag r-20260317-07.
deploybot: Starting canary rollout r-20260317-07 -> 5% in eu-west1. Tasks: [provision] [deploy] [smoke].
mike: thumbs up. Legal/compliance not required for this small runtime guard.
priya: posting update to customer-facing status for impacted EU tenants.
releasebot: r-20260317-07 status: canary started. Contact: tess (oncall).
10m_check (tess): completed 10m at 5% canary. No 5xx spike, p95 +8ms, gpu mem steady. Recommend ramp to 30%.
jordan: ack ramp to 30%.
deploybot: Ramp to 30% in eu-west1 initiated.
mike: watching for 30m. If OK we'll finish rollout and update changelog. Thanks all for quick approvals :thumbsup:
releasebot: r-20260317-07 rollout complete to eu-west1 100%.
kevin (ml-infra): Post-rollout sanity: OOMs back to baseline, p95 stable. No rollback needed.
tess (oncall): marking incident mitigated. I'll keep elevated monitoring for 24h. For customer-specific pins back to legacy, open a support ticket.
priya: summary for status page: "Hotfix deployed: KV-cache guard applied to redwood-quant-v2 (v2.1.3-quant-fix) — mitigated EU OOMs; no user-visible regression."
mike: posted to #customer-status, updated internal release notes with timeline.
releasebot: release r-20260317-07 closed. Changelog entry added.
deploybot: logs archived at s3://releases/r-20260317-07/logs
mike: follow-up: kevin will add automated KV-bounds tests to CI.
kevin (ml-infra): filed INFRA-1249 for CI tests.
priya: closing thread from releases side.
